examples.japanese: {氷|こおり}を{入|い}れて{冷|つめ}たくする。
examples.english: To make it cold by adding ice.
The ice is starting to melt.

examples.japanese: {湖|みずうみ}に{氷|こおり}が{張|は}った。

notes:
{氷|こおり} is ice in general.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {氷|こおり}が{張|は}る (ice forms)
- {氷|こおり}が{溶|と}ける (ice melts)
- {氷|こおり}を{入|い}れる (to add ice)
- {氷|こおり}の{上|うえ}で (on the ice)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {氷|こおり}{水|みず} (ice water)
- かき{氷|ごおり} (shaved ice dessert)
- {氷|こおり}{山|やま} (iceberg)
- {氷河|ひょうが} (glacier)

FIGURATIVE USES:
- {氷|こおり}のような (ice-cold, as in personality)
- {氷|こおり}が{解|と}ける (the ice breaks - becoming friendly)

NOTE: The reading changes to ごおり in some compounds (rendaku).
